fix_7_release_vs_all_same_period_xbrl.rule: every served release GAAP, company-level figure against every XBRL value the store holds for the same metric and dates, reported or derived. Agreement allows each side's rounding, and for a derived value the rounding of each filed figure it combines plus 0.05%. A disagreement is excused only by a documented restatement: the same concept reports the release value for that period in a 10-Q/10-K, a stock split the store documents (two reported per-share versions of one period at a whole ratio), or a release file whose other columns of the same row equal a later filing's restated figure and not the original. Against a reported value the release figure is dropped; a reported XBRL fact is never dropped. Against a derived value only, the release outranks it when the release came no more than 100 days after the derived value's filing, the same row (metric and normalised row label) agrees with reported XBRL in at least one period and disagrees in none, and the figure is not preliminary, not a x1000 or sign slip, not consolidated net income at a company with a noncontrolling interest, and no other release agrees with the derived value; the derived value then goes to data/derived_rejections.json, which ingest reads, and the companies are re-ingested. Otherwise the release figure is dropped
